selected_laps.description: Standard width (70px) balanced geometry with sweeping turns
Long high-speed straightaways terminating in sharp 90-degree corners
Constricted 20px corridor with extreme lateral wall proximity
Acute pinched hairpin geometry (f=0.50) with high lookahead beam penetration
Severe acute hairpin pinch (f=0.35) requiring maximum threshold braking

braking_onset.description: Transition from positive throttle or coasting to active negative braking

sustained_braking.description: Multiple consecutive steps of heavy longitudinal braking

high_steering_demand.description: High front wheel steering deflection (>15.0 degrees)

strong_diagonal_sensitivity.description: Strong anticipation cue on diagonal rangefinder beams

lateral_wall_proximity.description: Vehicle within 15px of boundary wall in narrow corridors

corner_approach.description: Approaching corner entry as road curvature begins increasing

corner_apex.description: Vehicle traversing the minimum radius apex of a corner

corner_exit.description: Vehicle exiting corner as curvature unwinds onto following straight

throttle_reapplication.description: Aggressive throttle application coming out of a corner or braking sequence

straight_line_cruising.description: Flat-out high-speed cruising along straight sections of track
